info.title: Aide API
info.description:
Aide's public API. The dashboard, personal access tokens and the MCP server all use these endpoints.

**Authentication.** `Authorization: Bearer oat_…` (a teammate's access token) or `Authorization: Bearer aide_live_…` (a workspace API key, created by an owner or admin under Settings > Developers). Either is bound to one account; every resource is scoped to it, and another account's id answers 404.

**API keys** act as the workspace, not as a teammate. Operations that list `apiKey` under security accept them; everything else (the session, `me`, members, teams, billing, conversations, saved views, notifications, helpdesk and widget settings, and API keys themselves) answers 403 `api_key_not_allowed`. A key with only the `read` scope gets 403 `insufficient_scope` on writes (every method but `GET`, except `POST /v1/knowledge/search`, which only reads). A revoked, expired or unknown key answers 401 `invalid_api_key`. Requests are rate limited per key.

**Webhooks.** Each delivery is a `POST` of the event JSON with `Aide-Event-Id`, `Aide-Event-Type`, `Aide-Delivery-Attempt` and `Aide-Signature: t=<unix seconds>,v1=<hex>`. `v1` is the HMAC-SHA256 of `${t}.${raw body}` keyed with the endpoint secret (`whsec_…`, the whole string). For 24 h after a rotation a second `v1`, signed with the previous secret, is included; accept the request if any `v1` matches and `t` is within 5 minutes. Answer 2xx within 10 s; anything else is retried with exponential backoff (8 attempts over about 4 h). An endpoint is disabled after 25 failed attempts in a row with no success for 24 h. Deduplicate on the event id.

**Responses.** Successful bodies are wrapped as `{ data }`. Page-numbered lists add `metadata`: `total` (exact up to 10,000, then 10,000 with `totalIsCapped: true`), `totalIsCapped`, `perPage`, `currentPage`, `lastPage` and `hasMore`. `page` runs from 1 to 500, and a page that starts past the first 10,000 rows answers 422 `page_too_deep`. `GET /v1/conversations` also takes a `cursor` (not with `page`): its `metadata.nextCursor` pages on in the same sort without counting, and a cursor page has null `total`, `currentPage` and `lastPage`. Message threads page with `before` and `meta.nextCursor`.

**Errors.** Every error is `{ error: { type, code, message, requestId, fields? } }`. Validation failures are 422 with one entry per field in `fields`.

**Rate limits.** Throttled routes return `X-RateLimit-Limit` and `X-RateLimit-Remaining`; a 429 adds `Retry-After` and `X-RateLimit-Reset`.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The previous page's `metadata.nextCursor`, in the same `sort`; not with `page`. A cursor from another sort, or one that does not decode, answers 422 `invalid_cursor`.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Only conversations in this inbox view, ANDed with the other filters: `needs_a_person`, `mine`, `unassigned`, `waiting`, `on_hold`, `closed`, `handled_by_aide`, `resolved_by_aide`, `handoffs`, `team:<team id>` (its conversations not closed or spam) or a saved view id. `drafts` and `suggested` filter on what conversations cannot be filtered by yet: a list answers 422 `unsupported_view_filter` and a count is null.

parameters.name: outcome
parameters.description: Conversations the analytics reports count with one of these outcomes. With no `startedAfter`, `startedBefore`, `orderedAfter` or `orderedBefore`, only conversations started in the last 90 days are classified.

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Up to 50 views to count, each counted as `GET /v1/conversations?view=` lists it, up to 10,000 (then `countIsCapped`): `needs_a_person`, `mine`, `unassigned`, `waiting`, `on_hold`, `closed`, `handled_by_aide`, `resolved_by_aide`, `handoffs`, `team:<team id>` (its conversations not closed or spam) or a saved view id. `drafts` and `suggested` filter on what conversations cannot be filtered by yet: a list answers 422 `unsupported_view_filter` and a count is null.

Error.description: Every error response, whatever the status (app/exceptions/handler.ts).

total.description: Matching rows, exact up to 10,000; past that, 10,000 with `totalIsCapped`.

Forbidden.description: The credential may not do this (`permission_error`).

NotFound.description: No such resource for this credential (`not_found`).

Error.description: Any other error, in the same envelope.

X-RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed in the current window.

X-RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

accessToken.description: An access token, bound to one account.

apiKey.description: A workspace API key. Acts as the workspace with the `read` and/or `write` scope; never as a teammate.
